notes: Title 49 uses a flat per-section URL convention. The Executive Branch Lobbying Disclosure Act in the 2025 codification is sections 49:71-78.1 (the regime prior's '49:71 through 49:83' range is approximate - 49:79-83 do not exist as separate sections in 2025; the act has been consolidated into 49:71-78.1). These per-section URLs are leaves (statute text, not directory pages).
